designNotes.scope: Compact Hex Vector at the global 200-pixel device height. General modulation belongs to the Hex host.
designNotes.oscillators: Four compact oscillators with ratio, frequency offset, level/modulation depth and independent keytrack sliders. Keytrack examples are 100%, 100%, 50% and 0%.
designNotes.keytrack: Vertical keytrack sliders fill upward from the bottom and have a small keyboard icon centered beneath each slider.
designNotes.oscillatorSwitches: Oscillator on/off buttons are one third of their previous width, have no visible label and use their full oscillator color when enabled.
designNotes.oscillatorControls: Ratio and Hz fields are 44 pixels wide; 12-pixel vertical keytrack sliders sit beside the on/off switches. Level knobs and readouts follow the compact field stack.
designNotes.oscillatorEditorGap: The envelope and harmonics panel sits 4 pixels after the oscillator rows. Reclaimed space increases the editor width while keeping its right edge aligned with the context panel.
designNotes.waveformEditor: Every oscillator has a waveform menu with sine, triangle, saw, square and Edit. Edit expands a collapsible device section with curve and harmonics views. The main device shows amplitude envelopes; harmonic painting is contained in the collapsible waveform section. Menu navigation, preset previews, expansion/collapse, tabs and Apply/Cancel are illustrative prototype states. Freehand drawing and synthesis remain unimplemented.
